verdicts.reason: A3 fails: the done-when never checks the brief's 'Do not reply yet' (no unchanged sent/reply count) or 'Read headers first', and matching opened N to marked N compares counts, not the two sets of ids.

All rules hold: a state diff (drafts +1 on one thread, sent count unchanged) plus a quote of the ask with a locator covers one thread, match the ask, and stop before send; status is assisted; 'unsupported' passes as a result; checkRunnable is honestly false.

All rules hold: a program computes strict-inequality overlaps as a count, both events are named, back-to-back slots are excluded, 0/0 and unread are valid results, status is assisted, and checkRunnable is honestly false.
A3 fails: the done-when checks that each item has a resolvable source quote but never enforces the brief's 'One agenda item per source' (no check that source ids are unique across items).

A3/A1 fail: the done-when hands the whole check to a person performing the booking, but never enforces the brief's 'Stop' (for example, no program state diff showing calendar events unchanged); a program could check the prepared sheet and that unchanged state, so human-only is not the only honest check.

A3/A1 fail: the done-when ends with a person paying, but never enforces the brief's 'Stop' (no state diff showing that no payment or checkout happened); a program could check the payment sheet's named fields, so human-only is not the only honest check.
